MoSPI signs MoU with Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology, Punjab for undertaking a Research Study
articles.full_content:
Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology, Punjab for undertaking a Research Study on development of a Predictive and Analytical Framework for Monthly Consumption Expenditures in India.
The signing ceremony was graced by Dr. Saurabh Garg, Secretary, MoSPI. Prof. Padmakumar Nair, Vice Chancellor, Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology and Shri R. Rajesh, Additional Director General, Capacity Development Division, MoSPI signed the MoU. Dr. Chandramani Sharma, Additional Director General, Coordination and Quality Control Division (CQCD), MoSPI and Dr. Sourav Chakrabortty, Deputy Director General, Research and Analysis Division (RAD), MoSPI were also present.
This collaboration aims to leverage the Household Consumption Expenditure (HCES) data by estimating Monthly Per Capita Consumption Expenditure (MPCE) at national and state levels, analysing household consumption patterns, and generating evidence for poverty estimation and broader economic planning. This is yet another initiative on the innovative use of AI in Official Statistics and highlights growing collaboration between MoSPI and academic institutions for research.
articles.summary: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology, Punjab for undertaking a Research Study on development of a Predictive and Analytical Framework for Monthly Consumption Expenditures in India. Padmakumar Nair, Vice Chancellor, Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology and Shri R. Rajesh, Additional Director General, Capacity Development Division, MoSPI signed the MoU.

Government calls for Accelerated Clean Energy Action as BRE Summit 2026 Roadshow Reaches Hyderabad
articles.full_content:
Third in a nationwide series, the Hyderabad roadshow convenes clean energy stakeholders ahead of the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo (BRE Summit) 2026 from 2 to 5 November at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi
Building on the momentum generated in Jaipur and Mumbai, leading voices from Government, industry and the renewable energy sector gathered today in Hyderabad for the third in a series of regional roadshows for the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo (BRE Summit) 2026, India's largest renewable energy summit and expo. As India accelerates toward its target of achieving 500 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity by 2030, the Hyderabad edition brought Telangana's formidable clean energy ecosystem into the national spotlight. the Hyderabad edition brought the diverse clean energy strengths and investment opportunities of Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu into the national spotlight.
The three southern States represent important and complementary strengths in India's clean energy transition, spanning renewable energy deployment, technology, manufacturing, industrial development, infrastructure, innovation and investment. With progressive policies and a growing pipeline of clean energy projects and opportunities, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu are well positioned to contribute to the next phase of India's renewable energy growth. Hosted by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), the roadshow brought together leaders from the Governments of Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu, the Sustainable Projects Developers Association (SPDA) and the Indian Solar Manufacturers Association (ISMA).
Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo 2026 will be held alongside the 9th Session of the International Solar Alliance (ISA) Assembly and the 4th International Conference on Green Hydrogen (ICGH), bringing together global leaders, policymakers, industry, investors and innovators on a common platform.
Shri Ravi Verma, Member-Governing Council, Sustainable Projects Developers Association gave the welcome remarks and set the context for the Roadshow.
Strengthening Industry Collaboration, the Hyderabad roadshow featured a comprehensive programme aimed at driving stakeholder engagement and showcasing the strategic blueprint of BRE Summit 2026. The proceedings included the screening of two curated films, India's Renewable Energy Journey and BRE Summit & Expo 2026, capturing the nation's clean energy transition and unveiling the scale of the upcoming summit in New Delhi.
A presentation by a senior representative from MNRE outlined the strategic objectives, core themes and proposed participation framework for global and domestic players. This was followed by a dedicated session on business opportunities and commercial engagement models for OEMs, project developers and investors, alongside a live walkthrough and demonstration of the official BRE Summit digital portal and mobile application.

NSO Appeals for Public Cooperation in Surveys to be Conducted During September 2026
articles.full_content:
1. The Field Operations Division of National Statistics Office (NSO) under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, Government of India is engaged in collecting information from households and establishments since 1950 which is used for planning and policy formulation both at National and State level.
2. Information is collected by trained officers of the NSO using hand-held digital devices (tablets) equipped with e-Sigma software and secure web portals designated for enterprise surveys. All information collected in these surveys is kept strictly confidential. The identity of households and enterprises participating in the survey is not disclosed in any report or published data. The data is used only for statistical purposes.
3. The detail of surveys undertaken by NSO (FOD) during the month of September, 2026 in various Districts is attached as Annexure-I. Further, for Wholesale Price Index, Purchaser Price Index, Index of Industrial Production and Annual Survey of Incorporated Service Sector Enterprises, selected units have been sent notices and are contacted by NSO (FOD) officials for data collection time to time. Similarly, for Rapid Survey of Functional Cooperatives (April-September, 2026), selected cooperatives are approached by NSO (FOD) officials for collecting the data.
4. The Government, therefore, requests all the citizens/enterprise mentioned in Annexure-I to kindly extend full cooperation to the survey officials and spare valuable time to provide correct and complete information. Participation from all the citizens helps in better planning and development for the benefit of the nation.

MSME-DFO Suri organises National Seminar on Export Promotion in Birbhum
articles.full_content:
Bolpur, Birbhum, August 31, 2026
In a significant initiative aimed at enhancing the global competitiveness of local enterprises, the Branch Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises–Development and Facilitation Office (MSME-DFO), Suri, organised a one-day National Seminar on Export Promotion at Bolpur, Santiniketan, Birbhum, on August 28, 2026.
The seminar brought together policymakers, financial institutions, technical institutes, trade bodies, entrepreneurs, artisans and aspiring exporters on a common platform to create greater awareness about international trade, regulatory requirements and opportunities for expanding the export footprint of MSMEs from the region.
The inaugural session was graced by the Minister of Higher Education, Technical Education, Training and Skill Development, Government of West Bengal, Shri Jagannath Chattopadhyay as the Chief Guest. MLA, Dubrajpur, Shri Anup Saha and MLA, Sainthia, Shri Krishna Kant Saha were also present on the occasion.
Delivering the keynote address, Director, MSME-DFO Kolkata, Shri P. K. Das emphasised the strategic importance of strengthening local manufacturing capabilities and enabling MSMEs to meet international quality, compliance and market requirements. He highlighted the need for enterprises to leverage available institutional support to expand their presence in global markets.
The seminar also witnessed participation from key financial and institutional stakeholders, including the Lead District Manager, Birbhum, Executive Officer, Khadi and Village Industries Board (KVIB), and Branch Manager, West Bengal Gramin Bank (WBGB). Their participation highlighted the importance of institutional convergence in facilitating credit linkages and providing financial support to enterprises seeking to enter or expand in international markets.
A major feature of the seminar was a series of technical sessions designed to provide entrepreneurs with practical and end-to-end guidance across different stages of the export process.
Representatives from the Export Promotion Council for Handicrafts (EPCH) and Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India (ECGC) addressed participants on opportunities for handicraft exports and mechanisms for mitigating trade-related credit risks through export credit insurance.
Experts from the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) and the Indian Institute of Packaging (IIP) focused on international marketing strategies, skill development and adherence to global packaging standards. The sessions highlighted the importance of appropriate packaging in reducing transit-related damage and enhancing the attractiveness and marketability of Indian products in international markets.
The session by National Institute of Technology (NIT) Durgapur focused on strengthening the linkage between academic research, technological innovation and industrial application, with emphasis on improving manufacturing capabilities and competitiveness.

Union Minister Shri Manohar Lal reviews Swachh Bharat Mission–Urban progress in Chandigarh; Directs Fast-track Project Implementation & Strengthening of Swachhata
articles.full_content:
The Union Minister of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) and Power, Shri Manohar Lal, chaired a review meeting on the progress of the Swachh Bharat Mission - Urban (SBM-U) in Chandigarh, held at the UT Guest House.
The meeting was also attended by Home Secretary-cum-Secretary, Local Government, UT Chandigarh, Sh. Mandip Singh Brar, IAS; Commissioner, Municipal Corporation Chandigarh, Sh. Amit Kumar, IAS; Deputy Commissioner, Chandigarh, Sh. Nishant Yadav, IAS; Special Commissioner, MCC, Sh. Harpreet Singh Sudan, IAS, besides senior officers of the Chandigarh Administration and Municipal Corporation, along with senior government officials from MoHUA, Director, SBM-U, Ms. Surabhi Malik and Advisor, CPHEEO, Ankit Jain, State government officials from Urban development department.
During the review, the Hon’ble Minister underscored the need to fast‑track Aspirational Toilet construction while ensuring that all existing facilities (CT/PTs) are regularly monitored, maintained, and kept fully functional and accessible to the public at all times.
He also reviewed preparations for the upcoming 15-day Swachhata Hi Seva 2026, directing that the Swachhata Pakhwada must actively engage citizens in every initiative during the 15‑day campaign. He emphasized that citizens are the true custodians of Swachhata, and their feedback must not only be heard but acted upon with utmost seriousness.The Hon'ble Minister highlighted that all processing facilities, waste collection vehicles, and government offices must be cleaned — just as homes are readied before Diwali — so that every element associated with swachhata reflects renewed commitment.
He further advocated cross‑learning among Urban Local Bodies, pointing to best practices from Integrated Command and Control Centres where AI and digital tools are used to track vehicles, capture real‑time data and derive smart solutions.
The Union Minister directed that a structured city‑to‑city learning mechanism be institutionalized, enabling knowledge sharing of processes, facilities, and innovations. The cities showcasing these best practices should be made accessible to the others for streamlining processes in various cities.
Satisfied with Chandigarh’s progress under SBM‑U 2.0, the Hon’ble Minister reiterated that beyond achieving swachhata, the greater responsibility lies in sustaining and continuously improving it.
